description: Source code for AndroidDexCompiler class, which implements a compiler for Android Dex files within a build system, including preparation and processing of compilation items, handling module dependencies, and invoking external tools.

classes.name: AndroidDexCompiler
classes.description: Implements a compiler for Android Dex files, managing preparation and execution of dex compilation tasks.

classes.name: PrepareAction
classes.description: Prepares compilation items for each module, determining output directories and dependencies.

classes.name: ProcessAction
classes.description: Executes the dex compilation process for prepared items, handling messaging and error reporting.

classes.name: DexItem
classes.description: Represents a compilation item for dexing, including module info, target, files, and configuration.

classes.name: MyValidityState
classes.description: Tracks validity state of a dex compilation item, including configuration parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the dex compilation process if a full build is detected.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description of the compiler, based on the dx tool filename.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the compilation configuration (always true here).

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a validity state object for caching purposes.

methods.name: getOutputDirectoryForDex
methods.description: Determines the output directory for dex files, considering Maven and non-Maven modules.

methods.name: addModuleOutputDir
methods.description: Adds directory children to a collection if they are directories.
